status: bounded AC1027 new-file maintenance coherence; no general writer promotion
authority: ODA v5.4.1 §§4.1, 7, 9 and 27. Fixed byte 0x0b is maintenance release; byte 0x12 is application maintenance. §7 identifies application maintenance 6 and 8 as known R2013 values. AuxHeader §27 has DWG version and three maintenance fields; these may include save history. Section/page rules and CRCs are in §§4.1 and 9.
change: For newly generated AC1027 only, write maintenance release 8 at fixed byte 0x0b and initialize all three AuxHeader maintenance fields to 8. The file remains at application maintenance 6 (byte 0x12), 0x0c=0 and application version 0x11=0; no other format version changes. For newly generated one-save files, repeating 8 follows the same-source ODA one-save AuxHeader pattern. Historical files may have different values and are not rewritten by this change.

source_evidence.provenance: A pre-existing LibreDWG test-data AC1027 file; companion text labels its LINE as from AutoCAD in 2014. The original authoring lineage is not independently established by this audit.
source_evidence.aux: LibreDWG 0.14 decodes current AUX DWG version 31 and maintenance 8; two historical version/maintenance pairs are 22/46, demonstrating these history fields are not universally identical to current values.
source_evidence.appinfo: The source AppInfo identifies AutoCAD; candidate AppInfo remains LibreCAD. No AutoCAD application identity is copied.
source_evidence.scope: Source-to-ODA conversion is a separately observed manual join. Source header/aux metadata and one LINE are independently decoded; source and returned DXF selected LINE coordinates match and ezdxf reports no errors or fixes.

additional_source: An independently authored ODA-produced AC1027 LINE DWG (SHA-256 1bab740b1f96b88534b4f8238828b9044cffd58b2975ec4b6b00db0c4560cd09) has fixed release 0x69, application maintenance 0x37, and its one-save AuxHeader version/maintenance pairs 31/0x69 repeated three times. Thus 0x0b and 0x12 are distinct fields and need not match.
profile_limit: No physical source with the complete candidate tuple 08/00/00/06 has been established. The spec explicitly allows 0x0c=0 but does not enumerate whether application-version 0x11=0 is a valid writer identity; this byte remains the established libdxfrw value and its AppInfo says LibreCAD. The source proves release 8, not this complete hybrid tuple. A controlled full-source-tuple variant 08/03/1f/08 with the same candidate AuxHeader also converted; its selected graph and LINE match the candidate and the two DXFs differed only in ODA-generated update timestamps. This does not establish universal validity of the hybrid or imply all applications accept it.
input_profile_matrix: For the same prior generated opt-in LINE file with no AuxHeader edits, fixed release 0 and 3 fail ODA; 4, 6, 8, 0x69 and 0x7d each produce a DXF with no .err under that selected drawing. Full observed tuples and fixed 08/00/00/08 also convert. These are diagnostics, not proof that arbitrary release values are equivalent or valid. The actual candidate is generated with AuxHeader copies =8; it is not byte-patched.
production_sample_scope: All nine DWGs are freshly generated with explicit default material and plotstyle opt-ins. ODA returned DXF without .err for each; hash-bound LibreDWG and ezdxf checks verify LINE/POINT/CIRCLE/ARC selected OCS/WCS geometry and material/plotstyle/layer graph, including tilted and negative normals. This is not complete drawing equivalence or a general writer support claim. ODA conversion lineage is an observed manual join.
crc_scope: For each of nine selected writer outputs, tools/audit_ac1027_maintenance_header.py checks encrypted primary header CRC32 and exact repeated encrypted copy, HEADER and CLASSES CRC16/sentinels, 8 discovered data-page header/data checksums and 2 system-page checksums. Header page count is 10. The page scanner and count are bounded to this writer sample and are not a general proof of arbitrary page-map membership; LibreDWG and native readers additionally decode the files. AppInfo contains LibreCAD.
native_compatibility: Current and older pre-candidate libdxfrw readers were separately compiled with tools/probe_ac1027_maintenance_native.cpp. Baseline and coherent candidate report identical selected LINE/VPORT/layer/material callbacks, coordinates, HANDSEED, 32 observed frames, zero entity/object/class/file-header CRC failures, and one HEADER compatibility warning (kind 24); neither had dropped integrity diagnostics. The earlier reader library was built from scratch 156b3946 and no ABI change is made. This is selected readback, not full semantic equivalence.
other_version_result: AC1018, AC1024 and AC1032 LINE files are byte-identical between the original and candidate writer18 object; AC1027 differs as intended.
strict_and_no_optin_limits: The strict CLI refuses both old and new material-opt-in samples at the same unqualified DWG MATERIAL graph gate and preserves destination. Both old and new no-material samples also fail strict output at the same opaque-callback gate (qualified=2/4), preserving destination. The candidate without material opt-in remains ODA-failed at LAYER; the header fix is not sufficient without the other required graph profiles.

validation.test_scope: Four-version output and AuxHeader checks, failure destination preservation and retry, native readback, repeated-header/section CRC controls, fixture-free checksum and source-profile negatives under Python -O.

commands.native_build: Compile tools/probe_ac1027_maintenance_native.cpp with -std=c++17 -Isrc -Itests against the candidate libdxfrw.a; repeat against 156b3946 headers/library. Read the old baseline and production line and compare stdout.
commands.factorial_note: The matched metadata profiles are scratch-only byte edits of one hash-bound old writer output; AUX changes are absent in those diagnostic variants. Full-tuple controls differ only in bytes 0x0c,0x11,0x12 from the coherent production candidate.

exact_writer_diff: The hash-bound old and new opt-in LINE outputs have equal length and differ in exactly 11 bytes: fixed byte 0x0b, the three AuxHeader maintenance bytes, and seven encrypted data-page header/checksum bytes. The auditor verifies both old/new page checksums, asserts those are the only permitted byte ranges, and binds both DWG hashes. The selected no-opt-in pair also has the same 11 changed offsets.
